_note: Seasonal campaigns: each shows on the site, in the newsletter and on the week's post page between 'from' and 'to'. 'hidden': true keeps one off until it's ready (e.g. driving experiences need the affiliate codes). Plan these 3 to 6 months out: nobody decides on Friday to go to a Grand Prix on Sunday.

campaigns.title: The 2027 calendar is in
campaigns.line: Le Mans, the TT, Monaco, Pikes Peak: the dates are out and the good beds go first.

campaigns.title: Christmas: give a race weekend
campaigns.line: A ticket to a 2027 race beats socks. Pick the race, build the trip, print it and put it in a card.

campaigns.title: Driving home for Christmas? Take the long way
campaigns.line: Swap a day of N1 for a pass or two. Fuel, night stops and the roads worth the detour.

campaigns.title: Long weekend: 20 to 22 March
campaigns.line: Human Rights Day falls on a Sunday, so the Monday's off. Three days is a proper ride.

campaigns.title: Easter: four days, 26 to 29 March
campaigns.line: Good Friday to Family Day. Enough for the Karoo and back, or the Swartberg both ways.

campaigns.title: Freedom Day is a Tuesday
campaigns.line: Take the Monday off and it's four days, 24 to 27 April.

campaigns.title: Father's Day, 20 June: give him a race weekend
campaigns.line: Not another tie. Pick a race, plan the trip, go together.

campaigns.title: Long weekend: 7 to 9 August
campaigns.line: Women's Day is a Monday. Three days, one good road.

campaigns.title: Heritage Day long weekend: 24 to 26 September
campaigns.line: Spring in the Karoo, flowers on the West Coast. Pick one.
